directions.plain: You mail pieces to small creators young women already follow. They post real wearing photos for you.
directions.title: Let Fans Show Your Pieces Worn
directions.why_for_you: Wearing shots get the most love, and creator posts get even more. Most creators you send to end up posting.
directions.you_would_do: Message about ten creators, send pieces to four to eight, and ask each for one wearing photo.

directions.caution: You spent nothing last month, so we have no paid history to learn from yet.
directions.plain: You put money behind your best photos to show them to more young women. It works fast and you can stop any time.
directions.title: Boost Best Posts To Young Women
directions.why_for_you: Your wearing shots already get the most love. Paid support can show those winners to women your age.
directions.you_would_do: Post three to five times a week and pick two wearing shots to support.

directions.caution: Creator posts can be slow to start, so early days may feel quiet.
directions.plain: You seed a few creators and also support top posts with money. You learn fast without betting all on one idea.
directions.title: Half Creators Half Boosted Posts Mix
directions.why_for_you: Creator posts earn the most attention and your wearing shots lead brand posts. Last month you were close to goal with no spend, so a small lift may help.
directions.you_would_do: Message about eight creators to seed two to four, post three to five times, and support the best wearing shot.

directions.caution: Use sales rarely, or shoppers will learn to wait for the next one.
directions.plain: You pick one week with a small discount on all pieces. Shoppers who waited get a reason to buy now.
directions.title: Run One Simple Discount Week Only
directions.why_for_you: Sales lift buying a lot for shops like yours. Last month you were close to goal with no sale, so one week may close the gap.
directions.you_would_do: Post four to five times that week, show wearing shots daily, and keep the discount to seven days.
